message.content:
Fix one low review finding on change 326 (trail 499), the test-only branch `test/session-equals-cold` (PR #528, head 5c0f8d3d) in the caliper repo. In your worktree: `git fetch origin`, `git switch -c fix-session-test origin/test/session-equals-cold`; push with `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/test/session-equals-cold` (normal fast-forward, never force; if origin/main moved merge it in with a merge commit only if needed to keep the branch buildable). You own only crates/core/tests/session_equals_cold.rs. Read first: /Users/gabe/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/memory/worker-contract.md, AGENTS.md ('Testing discipline'). Rules: signed commit with trailer `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED`; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` first; one cargo process at a time; scratch under /tmp/claude-501/. Final message max 70 words. Cap 40 tool calls; never ask questions.

FINDING (low): `seeds()` accepts any u64 (line ~303), and `SEED=555123` generates a `delete` at step 12 after all seven files have already been removed; that passes ZERO to `Lcg::below` (line ~25), which panics on the modulo before the equivalence assertions run. When no files remain, choose a different edit (for example re-adding a removed file). Fix the CLASS: make `Lcg::below(0)` impossible by construction: have every edit-selection step compute its candidate list first and pick only among EXISTING candidates, and if a kind of edit has no candidates choose another kind (a total function `next_edit(state) -> Edit` that never panics, for ANY seed); additionally `Lcg::below` takes `NonZeroUsize` (or asserts with a message naming the caller) so a future zero fails loudly with context. Add a test that runs a brute-force sweep of seeds 0..2000 for 12-30 steps each using ONLY the edit generator (no extraction, a fast pure test) and asserts it never panics and that every generated edit is applicable to the model state; also keep `SEED=555123` as a regression row. The existing 20 seeds x 12 edits must still pass unchanged in meaning (the edit sequences for the existing seeds may change only if they hit an empty-candidate step; say if any did). Gates by exit code: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-core session_equals_cold`. Mutation-prove: reintroduce the unguarded `below(0)` and show the sweep test fails.
